cEtanyaH

puM, (cetana eva । svArTe zyaY .) Bagavadava tAraviSezaH । tasya pramARaM yaTA, -- “SrutvA tu kaliDarmmAMstAn brahmA lokapitAmahaH । sarvvalokahitArTAya provAca maDusUdanam ॥ Bavizyati kalO kenopAyena DarmmapAlanam । BaktimArgasTitiH kasmAttadbadasva jagadguro ! ॥ SrIBagavAnuvAca । avatIrRo BavizyAmi kalO nijagaREH saha । SacIgarBe navadvIpe svarDunIparivArite ॥ aprakASyamidaM guhyaM na prakASyaM vahirmuKe । BaktAvatAraM BaktAKyaM BaktaM BaktipradaM svayam ॥ manmAyAmohitAH kecinna jYAsyanti vahirmmuKAH । jYAsyanti madBaktiyutAH sADavo nyAsino'malAH ॥ kfzRAvatArakAle yAH striyo ye puruzAH priyAH । kalO te'vatarizyanti SrIdAmasuvalAdayaH ॥ catuHzazwirmahAntaste gopA dvAdaSa bAlakAH । DarmmasaMsTApanArTAya viharizyAmi tEraham ॥ kAle nazwaM BaktipaTaM sTApayizyAmyahaM punaH । kfzRaScEtanyagOrANgo gOracandro gOrahariH ॥ SacIsutaH praBurgOro nAmAni BaktidAni me । gacCantu Buvi te puttrA jAyantAM BaktarUpiRaH ॥ DarmmasaMsTApanaM kAle kurvvantu te mamAjYAyA । kfzRAvatArakAle ye madBaktAstAn SfRu kramAt ॥ SrIdAmanAmagopAlo mama rAmasya ca priyaH । aBirAma iti KyAtaH pfTivyAM sa Bavizyati ॥ sudAmanAmagopAlaH SrImAn sundaraWakkuraH । vasudAmapriyasaKaH SrIDanaYjayapaRqitaH ॥ subalo me priyasaKo gOrIdAsAKyapaRqitaH । kamalAkarapippalAiH pUrvvaKyAto mahAbalaH ॥ mahAbAhurgopabAlaH SrImAn sAhasapaRqitaH ॥ puruzottamo vESyakule stokakfzRaH priyo mama । arjjunaH pUrvvadehe yaH kalO SrIparameSvaraH ॥ pUrvvapriyo lavaNgo me kfzRAKyaH sa kalO yuge । SrIDaraH SrIDarasamaH pUrvve SrImaDumaNgalaH ॥ subalo balarAmasaKaH kalO SrIlahalAyuDaH । dvAdaSEte Bavizyanti kalO madDarmmarakzaRe ॥ catuHzazwirmahAnto ye striyaH kecicca pUruzAH । purA gopANganAH KyAtAH kalO tAH puruzA Buvi ॥ yatiryasmAt kalO cAhaM tadarTe puruzAH striyaH । nIlAmbaraScakravarttI gargaH KyAto muniH purA ॥ atipriyA rADikA me SrIgadADarapaRqitaH । rADikAyAH priyAMSaH sa SrIgadADaraWakkuraH ॥ maDumatI priyasaKI SrInaraharisaMjYakaH । vfndA devI prARasaKI SrImukundaH kalO yuge ॥ candrAvalI prARatulyA kavirAjaH sadASivaH । lalitA yA saKI muKyA jagadAnandapaRqitaH ॥ viSAKA yA priyasaKI SrIdAmodaranAmakaH । vanamAlI kavirAjaH SrIviSAKA saKI mama ॥ SrIraGunATaBawwaSca raNgadevI mama priyA । SrIgadADaraBawwastu sudevI sA mama priyA ॥ praboDAnandaviKyAtastuNgavidyA taTA priyA । SrIlarAGavagosvAmI campakAKyA latA priyA ॥ gosvAmI SrIlaBUgarBa indulesvA taTA priyA । kASimiSraH SaSireKA rUpaH SrIrUpamaYjarI ॥ SrIsanAtanagosvAmI priyA SrIratimaYjarI । SrIraGunATadAsaH SrIsvarUpamaYjarI mama ॥ dvitIyo raGunATaSca SrIrAgamaYjarI priyA । SrIlagopAlaBawwaH SrI-anaNgamaYjarI saKI ॥ lokanATaH premaBakto lavaNgamaYjarI saKI । SrIgadADaraBawwastu priyA SrIguRamaYjarI ॥ BawwaH SrIjIvagosvAmI yogamAyA sahATinI । dUtI kalAvatI prezyA SrIgovindaH priyo mama ॥ dUtI lIlAvatI SrImAn mADavaH prItivardDanaH । vAsuGozABiDo dUtI mamAnandapradAyinI ॥ SrISivAnandaBAryyA sA matpriyendumatI saKI । SrIparamAnandapuri priyo me udDavaH saKA ॥ SrIlarAGavadAsastu DanizWA me priyA saKI । SuklAmbaro brahmacArI yAjYiko brAhmaRaH smftaH ॥ paRqito jagadISaSca yajYapatnI mama priyA । AcAryyaH SrIlaBagavAn SrIcEtanyapriyAMSaBAk ॥ paRqito garuqaH SrImAn garuqo mama vAhanaH । SrIlagopInATasiMho'krUro Bakto mama priyaH ॥ GozaH SaNkara AKyAto guRasAgararAyakaH । mADavaH SAntanumunirviSvakarmmA tu BAskaraH ॥ vanamAlI sudAmA ca sArvvaBOmo bfhaspatiH । priyA indumuKI yA me makaraDvajaviSrutaH ॥ siMhAnando lokanATaH kavicandrastataH param । SrInATo rAmanATaSca catvAraH sanakAdayaH ॥ kASimiSrastu kubjA syAdrAmAnando'rjjunaH saKA । pratAparudraH KyAto'sAvindradyumno mahIpatiH ॥ WakkuraSca kAlidAsaH pulindIvanacAriRI । SiKIcarADikA dAsI mA iti KyAtisaMyutA ॥ AcAryyagopInATaSca ratnAvatI mama priyA । SArggadAsaH padminI syAt sUryyo viSveSvaraH smftaH ॥ BAnumatI satyarAjo rAmAnandaH kalAvatI । jayaSca vijayaScEva govindo garuqastaTA ॥ AcAryyaratnaScandraH syAdbyAso vfndAvanaH smftaH । SukadevA vyAsaputtro Bawwo vallaBa IritaH ॥ SivAnando'bjaja iva devAnandaSca BArgavaH । paRqitaH SrIjagannATo durvvAsA munirucyate ॥ AcAryyaH SrI-anantaSca haridAsastaTEva ca । etA gopyo vraje KyAtA hfdayAnanda eva ca ॥ priyAScatuHzazwirete DarmmasaMsTApane kalO । etezAM puRyanAmAni ye smaranti dine dine ॥ te prApnuvanti madBaktiM punanti Buvanatrayam । madBaktadAsA ye martyA nAsti tezAM samaH kvacit ॥ SrutvA Bagavato vAkyaM brahmA harzamavAptavAn । stOti taM devadeveSaM nedurdanduBayastadA ॥ jagurganDarvvapravarAstumburupramuKAstadA ॥” ityanantasaMhitAyAM SrIcEtanyajanmaKaRqe saptapaYcASattamo'DyAyaH ॥ * ॥ api ca । “yaH satye sitavarRamAdaDadasO SrISuklanAmABavat tretAyAM maKaBuk maKAKya ucito'BUdraktavarRaM daDat । yaH SyAmaM daDadASu varRakamamuM SyAmo yuge dbApare so'yaM gOraviDurvviBAti kalayannAmAvatAraM kalO ॥ nityAnando BaktarUpo vraje yaH SrIhalAyuDaH । BaktAvatAra AcAryyo'dvEto TaH SrIsadASivaH ॥” iti gOragaRoddeSaH ॥ (ayameva BagavAMScEtanyadevo navInavEzRavasampradAyaviSezasya pravarttakastatsampadAyEScopAsyezwadevatvenAsO parigfhItaSca । asO eva vfndAvanaramaRa-SrIkfzRasya pUrRAvatAra iti kecit, parEstu prAmARikagranTavacanAdarSanAt tanna manyate ataevAsmin vizaye paRqitAnAM prAyaSo mataBedo dfSyate । sa tu praBuH (1407) saptADikacaturddaSaSataSake kumBasTe savitari pOrRamAsyAM tiTO SukravAre pradozasamaye navadvIpAKyanagaryyAM prAdurbaBUva । tasminneva mahAmahimnastasya Bagavato janmasamaye candradevaM prati sEMhikeyoparAgo jAtaH । etadupalakzIkftya gaNgAsnAnArTaM bahavo lokA nAnAdigdeSAdAgatya tatra militAH । tadA graste'pi rAhuRA candramasi BaktajanakumudabAnDavo gOracandraH samavetalokAnAM harisaMkIrttanapraBftiBirmaNgalAcaraREH sahaSacIpUrvvaparvvatAdudiyAya । Bavanti hi SuBasUcakAni mahatAmAviBUtAni । atastadApi prasannA dik SEtyasOganDyamAndyAdiguRagaRAQyo malayasamIraRaH prasannAni ca sADu janamanAMsi samaBavan । asya pitA jagannATamiSrastu purA SrIhawwanivAsI AsIt । kadAcit gaNgAsnAnArTameva navadvIpamAgatya vipracakravarttikulatilakasya nIlAmbaraSarmmaRaH SacInAmnIM kanyAM pariRItavAn । tato gacCati kAle ayaM cEtanyadevaH SacIgarBe trayodaSamAsaM yAvaduzitvA jagannATamiSrasya daSamaputtratvena samaBavat । asya pUrvvajo viSvarUpo nAma jagannATamiSrasyAparaH puttra AsIt । sa tu yOvana eva jYAnavErAgyaviSArado dAraparigrahamanaNgIkurvvan pArivrAjyaDarmmaM samASrayat । aTa cEtanyadevasya jAtakarmmAdisaM skAre yaTAkAlaM kramaSo nivftte asya mAtAmaho nIlAmbaracakravarttI sulakzaRAdikamavalokya viSvamBara iti nAmnEnamAjuhAva । SacIdevI tu punaH punaH puttraDanena vaYcitA priyatamamenaM kanIyAMsaM saMsArasTitidIrGajIvanakAmanayA nimAi ityAKyayA pOravAsinastu asAmAnyarUpalAvaRyatayA paramasamAdareRa gOra ityAKyayA ca AhUtavantaH । paraM DarmmarasikAnAM BaktAnAM samAje, SAkyasiMhasya budDadeva iva asya mahApraBuriti cEtanyadeva iti ca AKyA prasidDA । aTa prApte kAle cEtanyadevo'yaM SAstrasAgarapAragamaSezabuDavargavanditacaraRAravindaM mahAmahopADyAyaM gaNgAdAsaSarmmARamupADyAyatvenANgIkftya svalpenEva kAlena sarvvaSAstrArTatattvajYaH samaBavat । asya budDiprAKaryyamavagamya tadA sarvva evEnaM devAMSasamBUtamamanyanta । aTa kadAcidayaM gaNgAsnAnArTaM gatvA tatra vallaBAcAryyasya lokAtItarUpalAvaRyAM lakzmIM nAma kanyAmavalokya mohita AsIt । vallaBAcAryyastu etadavagamya svayameva tAM kanyAmasmE sampradade । vivAhAnantaramevAsO CAtrAnaDyApayituM pravfttaH । etasminneva samaye bahavA digavijayinaH paRqitA navadvIpamAgatya asya tarkajAlEH samAcCannA BagnadarpASca santaH pratinivfttAH । asAvapi digvijigIzayA pUrvvAdisTalIM gatvA tatrasTAn paRqitAn vimohayan suvimalaM yaSaH prAptavAn । etasminneva kAle asya pUrvvapatnI kAlaDarmmaM prAptA । cEtanyadevastu tasyA viraheRa vyAkulito'pi mAturanuroDenEva punaH sanAtanapaRqitasya vizRupriyAnAmnIM kanyAM dvitIyapatnItvena svIcakAra । paraM sarvvaguRaviBUzitAyAH sAkzAt lakzmyA iva lakzmyA maraRAdevAsO saMsAraviraktaH SrIvAsAdiBirBaktavargErmilito hariBaktirasanimagna eva kAlaM yApayAmAsa । aTa kadAcit pitflokodDAravAsanayA gayAtIrTaM gatvA BaktacUqAmaReH SrImadISvarapurinAmno gosvAminaH sakASAt harinAmAmftadIkzAM labDvAtmAnaM kftakftArTaM matvA ca svadeSaM pratyAvfttavAn । etasminnavasare pAzaRqadurAcArO dasyupravarO jagAi mADAi ceti prasidDO brahmabanDU anyAMSca kuzWAdivyADipIqitAn mahApAtakinaH karuRayA harinAmadIkzAdAnena saMsArasAgarAt samudDftya yavanajAtIyakAjipraBftIn vEzRavadveziRaH svamahimnA damayAmAsa । tataH praBftyevAsO BaktirasapraDAnaM vEzRavaDarmmaM pracArayitumicCan nityAnandAdbEtAcAryyAdiBirBaktavargEH saha nAnAjanapadaM pariBraman bahUneva janAn premonmattAnakarot । aTa (1431) ekatriMSadaDikacaturddaSaSataSake uttarAyaRasaMkrAntyAM saMsAramAyAM parityajya kAwoyAKyagrAme keSavaBAratisakASAt sannyAsaDarmmaM samASrayat । aTa nIlAcalamAgatya SrIjagannATadevaM dfzwvA rAjYaH pratApAdityasya saBApaRqitaM vedAntaSAstrapAradarSinaMsArvvaBOmaM vicAreRa parAjitya vEzRavadIkzAM pradattavAn । aTa kadAcit godAvarItIre BaktavaraM rAmAnandamavalokya sevyanirRayErDarmmAlApErAtmAnaM kftakftyavadamanyata । tato'sO tripadI-SivakAYcI-vizRukAYcI-trimallapraBftIn bahUn dAkziRAtyajanapadAn haripremarasena plAvayitvA dvArakAtIrTadarSanArTaM prasTitaH । tatrEvAsO ‘kfzRakarRAmftaM’ nAma suprasidDavEzRavagranTaM labDavAn । ataH paraM punareva nIlAcalamAgatya kASISvaranAmnaH kasyacidBaktapraDAnasya Bavane avasTitavAn । atrevAsO SrISrIjagannATadevasya raTayAtrAmahotsave harisaMkIrttanAdikaM viDAya premonmAdapralApAdiBirBaktilakzaRaM darSayAmAsa । aTa gacCati kAle vfndAvanaM jigamizurvanyenEva paTA vrajan svaBAvasAralyena vyAGrAdInapi hiMsrajantUn BaktipremRA mAdayitvA vfndAvanamupatasTe । tatra svaBaktavfndAvfta evAsO gopIvallaBaSrIkfzRasya vihArasTAnAdikamavalokya maTurAmuddiSya prasTitaH । tato'smAt sTAnAt prayAgagamanakAle bahUn pAzaRqAnapi yavanAn hariBaktAn viDAya vArARasImupasTitaH । tatra kiyatkAlamuzitvA svaDarmmaM pracAryya ca punarnIlAcalamAjagAma । atrasTa evAsO svapracAritavEzRavaDarmmasya mAhAtmyaM vijYApayituM BaktavfndAgragaRyAn rUpasanAtanAdIn nAnAtIrTasTAnezu prezayAmAsa । aTa svaBaktErmilito nAnAviDamahotsavena harisaMkIrttanAdikaM viDAya Baktirasasya utkawakowimaBigamya virahonmAdAdipragAQaBaktilakzaREranvita AsIt । tata evAsO svaBaktagaRAn kaliyuge harisaMkIrttanasya mAhAtmyAdikaM SrAvayitvA azwacatvAriMSadvarzavayasi kAlasya duratikramaRIyatvAt (1455) paYcapaYcASadaDikacaturddaSaSataSake mAnavakAyaM parityajya antarhitavAn ॥)

v: pu॰ ASva॰ gfhyokte yajYaBede tasya viDAnAdi” yaTA “cEtyayajYe prAk svizwakftaScEtyAya baliM haret” sU॰ । cEtye BavAScEtyAH । SaNkaraH paSupatiH AryA jyezWA ityevamAdayaH । yadi kasyEciddevatAyE prati SfRoti yadi Atmano'BipretaM vastu labDaM tatastvA mahamAjyena sTAlIpAkena paSunA vA yakzyAmIti tatolabDe vastuni tasya tena yAgaM kuryAt sa cEtyayajYaH । tatra svizwakftaH prAk cEtyAya baliM haret namaskArAntena nAmaDeyena punaScEtyasya grahaRaM pratyakzaharaRArTam । tena cEtyAyatane evopalepanAdi kuryyAt” nA॰ vf॰ । “yadyu bE videSasTaM palASadUtena yatra vecCA vanaspate ityetayarcA dvO piRqO kftvA vIbaDe'ByAGAya dUtAya prayacCedimantasmE baliM hareti cEnaM brUyAdayaM tuByamiti yo dUtAya” sU॰ । “yadi videSasTaM cEtyaM yajet tadA palASadUtena baliM haret । palASena dUtaM vIvaDaYca kuryAt । yatra vecCetyfcA dvO piRqO kftvA vIvaDe'ByADAya dUtAya prayacCet । tayorekaM piRqaM nirdiSya dUtaM vadati imaM tasmE baliM hareti । aparaM dUtAya prayacCati ayaM tuByamiti । etayarceti vacanam anyatra pAdagrahaRe'pi kvacit sUktaM BavatItTeva marTam । tena “AtvAhArzamantareDIti fzaBaM mA samAnAnAmiti” ca sUktaM sidDam । anye punaraByAsArTaM manyante piRqakaraRe vIvaDAByADAne dUtAya pradAne iti nA॰ vf॰ । “prati BayaM cedantarA Sastramapi kiYcit” sU॰ । “karttuScEtyasya ca maDye Bayamasti cet Sastramapi kiYcit dadyAt dUtAya” nA॰ vf॰ । “nAvyA cet nadyantarA plavarUpamapi kiYcidanena taritavyamiti” sU॰ । “uBayormaDye yadi nAvA tAryA nadI syAt tadA plavarUpamapi kiYcit dadyAt aneneti mantreRa” nA॰ vf॰ । “DanvantariyajYe brahmARamagniM cAntarA purohitAyAgre baliM haret” sU॰ । “yadi Danvantari ScEtyo Bavati tadA vrahmARamagniM cAntarA purohitAyAgre baliM haret purohitAya nama iti tato Danvantaraye nama iti । DanvantarO videSasTe tvayaM viSezaH DanvantareSca purohitasya cEkaH piRqaH dvitIyo dUtasya” । nA॰ vf॰ ।
m: चैत्य—यज्ञ m. a sacrificial ceremony performed at a monument, ĀśvGṛ. i, 12.
चैटयतायनि m. patr. fr. ˚त, g. तिकादि.
